notes.subject: car
notes.text: A pickup truck with cab and bed is visible in most coverage; Generation 3 has a roof rack. Sometimes a big blur covers the whole truck.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A police car, usually white or black, nearly always follows the Street View car.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Short plates that look somewhat green through the blur.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Concrete poles with indents and a few horizontal supports, like those in Brazil but without holes through them.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Roads are often poorly kept: missing or faded lines, potholes, cracks and unpaved stretches.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Mostly single-storey houses with steep metal-sheet roofs, often inside cinder-block walls.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: State and city names show up often on shopfronts and banners, so knowing them helps.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: Low-quality official coverage is unusual for mainland Africa. The 2023-2025 batches are extremely blurry, a trait shared only with Lebanon.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Rainforest with abundant palms in the far south, savannah in the middle, and sparse arid steppe in the far north.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The south is mainly Christian and the north mainly Muslim, so hijabs and Muslim dress are more common in the north.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Large haystacks are very common and almost only seen in Kaduna state.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Arid but green farmland with lots of corn points to Kano, covered only by low-quality camera.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Lush grass, reddish soil, scattered trees and thatched huts suggest Benue.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Northwestern highways are very open and arid, with few or no trees, all low-quality coverage.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Savannah with rocky hills is typical of the northeast, in Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe and Adamawa.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Monolithic mountains of exposed weathered rock are common around the capital.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Flat, sandy coast with many palms east of Lekki, almost all old Generation 3 with a silver follow car.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The Obudu Plateau road climbs the tallest mountains with coverage, green, foggy and wet.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Dark red soil is most common in and around Benin City and Enugu.
